jsonld.name: Delta Pro Retractable Roof
jsonld.description:
It is one of the most popular outdoor space expansion solutions. It is suitable for large outdoor spaces. The fabric stretches and moves with the aluminum track through a special motor. When it is opened, customers can feel the sunshine and air of nature. After closing, it can be 100% waterproof and effectively block the sun. It is very good in terms of heat insulation effect and aesthetics.

Enjoy shade or sunlight exactly where you want it with the Dover Motorised Pergola. Its free-standing design lets you position it anywhere in your garden or poolside space.

The motorised roof glides open and closed at the touch of a button, giving you full control over sunlight and cover. When fully retracted, the pergola offers an unobstructed view of the sky, perfect for star-gazing or enjoying a sunny day.

Constructed from durable, weather-resistant PVC fabric that resists mildew, it’s built to perform in all seasons with minimal upkeep. Sleek lines and integrated LED lighting create a contemporary outdoor feature that suits dining, lounging, or entertaining alike
